summary: Azitra, Inc. filed an 8-K to report that it will convene its 2026 annual meeting on June 4, 2026, and immediately adjourn to June 15, 2026, due to a minor administrative delay in mailing proxy materials. The record date of April 24, 2026, remains unchanged. No proposals were altered. This is a routine procedural adjournment of a shareholder meeting, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, or strategic changes disclosed. The filing reflects ordinary corporate governance logistics with no actionable special-situation catalyst.
